world.org_type: third-party administrator of occupational pension schemes and a master trust, nine member-service case queues

driver: The outcome a unit is judged on falls steeply with the number of parallel servers it runs at an unchanged load per server, so an expectation built on that ratio alone sits above every small unit and below every large one, and the unit whose outcome genuinely exceeds what its own load and server count imply sits mid-pack on any ratio-based residual while the smallest unit tops it.
driver_concrete: The share of member-service cases answered outside target that a queue's own offered load and staffed positions imply is read off the queue's own earlier quarters, and matching those quarters on the load divided by the staffed positions instead of on the load itself reads Member data corrections' five-position FY2026 quarters against the fourteen-position quarters it ran at the same occupancy while a remediation programme carried nearly three times the caseload, so it reports a 16.0 point gap there and only 10.2 for Contribution queries, whose load and roster never moved.
stump: A competent solver rebuilds every queue's FY2026 breach share correctly across both case systems on the financial year with the clock rules and the unanswered cases applied, compares each queue with its own FY2023 to FY2025 quarters at the same load per staffed position, and commits Member data corrections at 25.8 per cent, because that queue carried fourteen positions through the two years its own history is read from and five in FY2026.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who has stacked both case systems, de-duplicated the cutover, converted the stamps, applied the clock and the exclusions and counted the unanswered cases divides each quarter's offered load by its staffed positions, reads each queue's own history at that occupancy, and commits Member data corrections at 25.8 per cent, because occupancy is the field's workload measure and the record offers a clean within-queue comparison on it.
domain_test: The quantity that decides is the share of cases answered outside target that a queue's own offered load and staffed positions imply, which is the service-operations estimate of an achieved service level and falls with the number of positions at fixed occupancy (the square-root staffing relation behind every contact-centre and back-office capacity model); swap the nouns to megawatt-hours or school places and there is no pooled arrival stream served by a counted number of parallel servers, so nothing makes the expectation depend on the server count as well as on the load per server and the task stops being about anything.

differentiation.task194: task194's architecture 2 also measured each candidate against what its own conditions imply, but there the expectation came from an external standard fixed at a stale vintage and the move was to re-base it; here the expectation is read off the administrator's own clean queue-quarters and the move is that it is a function of the server count as well as of the load per server, which no re-basing supplies.
differentiation.task187: task187 turned on averaging a capped curved response over a spread of inputs (a Jensen gap inside one unit); here each unit's expectation is a point value and the error is an omitted second argument (scale) across units, so the small units are over-served by the pooled curve rather than the wide-spread ones.
differentiation.task191: task191's move was to judge the largest of many candidates against the largest a quiet set produces (a selection effect in the noise); here every queue carries thousands of cases a quarter and the shortfall is systematic, not sampling, so a correct multiplicity or shrinkage treatment still files the wrong queue.
differentiation.task129: task129's architecture 1 sat in this house domain and subdomain and was re-rooted away before any data was cut; its driver was web performance engineering and nothing of it is reused.

notes: stump_strategy other: the decisive move is a specification error in the expectation (an omitted scale argument in a queueing service-level estimate), which none of the listed families names honestly. It is not composition_mix (no mix shift or reweighting of strata), not population_selection (the population is filed and includes the unanswered cases), not maturity_censoring (the window closes a month before the extract and the unanswered cases are a filed part of the estimand, not the decisive step), not grain_or_unit (the unit of the decision is the queue in every reading) and not uncertainty_hold (the shortfall is systematic, with thousands of cases per queue-quarter). forum regulator_or_inspector: the Pensions Authority receives the service improvement response. Three rules answered in the design note. generators G14 first: the decisive move is a yield conditioned on a second argument (the staffed position count) and not only on the load per position; G16 is held by task241 and G12, which carries the unanswered-case rung, is held by task194.
